name: Schemes Of HP Minorities Finance & Development Corporation
benefit: Loans are given for self-employment for 5 years at 6 percent interest rate up to Rs.5.00 lakh. Loans for professional and technical education like JBT, Nursing, Hotel Management, MBA, MBBS, Engineering, LLB and B.Ed etc. are given at 3% interest rate up to Rs 10,00 lakh. The age of the applicant should be between 16 years to 32 years.
eligibility_rules: Individuals belonging to minority communities (Sikhs, Muslims, Christians, Buddhists, Jains and Parsis) in the age group of 18 years to 55 years whose annual income is Rs.98,000/- (rural areas) and Rs.1,20,000/- (urban areas) be less than.
documents_required: It is mandatory for the eligible person to submit his application on the prescribed form along with Caste
certificate. Income certificate. Age certificate. Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline It is mandatory for the eligible person to submit his application on the prescribed form along with caste certificate, income certificate, age certificate and Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate.
